Redevelopment and Housing Authority
March 19, 1973
Mr. Theodore R. Robb Regional Administrator Department of Housing and Urban Development Curtis Building 6th and Walnut Streets Philadelphia, Pennsylvania 19106
Dear Mr. Robb:
Draft Environmental Statement Randolph Urban Renewal Project VA R-58, Richmond, Virginia
Our staff has reviewed the subject Statement and concur in its findings. We believe that the Statement accurately reflects the environmental impacts of the proposed renewal program and other actions which might occur in the urban renewal area.
The berm proposed as the solution to the adverse noise impact of the Richmond Metropolitan Expressway does not appear unreasonable at this time. After execution of a Loan and Grant Contract for the Randolph Urban Renewal Area, the Authority will take the necessary steps required to resolve the adverse impacts set forth in the Statement.
If you have need of any additional comment or if you have any questions with regard to the above, please contact us.
Frederic A. Fay Executive Director
